description: Starter golden set for apps/api/scripts/rag-eval.ts. Each case names the exact filename(s) a correct retrieval should surface for the given query. This set currently targets the synthetic documents uploaded while testing the async document-upload architecture (see conversation history) — several of them intentionally share near-identical wording ('async document processing pipeline', a Stage/Owner table) to exercise table extraction across formats, which makes them a weak test of *semantic* distinctness. Replace or extend this file with queries against real user documents as the corpus grows; keep the multi-file case (table-owners) as a template for queries where more than one document is a valid hit.

cases.query: How does the AI service prove it downloads files through the real file-upload SDK instead of a hand-rolled HMAC client?
What product is this, what version, and who is the team lead?
List people with their role and department.
Which table lists Upload owned by the NestJS API and Parse+Embed owned by the AI service?
cases.notes: Multiple documents contain this exact table — any one of them counts as a hit. Template for queries with more than one valid answer.

cases.query: Which markdown document explains chunking by heading?
